text: Staying out of it feels safe. Five hundred years ago, one man saw it differently.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Ancient Greece. King Antiochus marches in to drive out Rome. Both send envoys to the Achaeans.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Antiochus says... stay neutral. Rome says... take up arms.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Rome warns... stay out, and you get no favour. You're just the winner's prize.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Machiavelli saw the pattern... he who is not your friend will demand your neutrality, whilst he who is your friend will entreat you to declare yourself.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Team meeting. Two plans. Both leads look at you... and you say, both are good.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Plan A wins. Its lead remembers you didn't help. The other... remembers you didn't either.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He's blunt about it... irresolute princes, to avoid present dangers, generally follow the neutral path, and are generally ruined.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Is picking a side safe? No. No path is perfectly safe, he admits. Choose the lesser risk... eyes open.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Taking a side isn't taking a swing. It's saying where you stand... and why.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Tonight, one choice you keep dodging with, either is fine... give your real answer. Kindly, with a reason.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: When did staying neutral cost you? Tell us below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... we don't sit on the fence.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
